messages:
sara (support): FYI customer ACME opened a ticket: missing audit logs for API calls between 2024-09-22 03:15 and 2024-09-24 02:50 UTC. They reported the issue after a KMS rotation. Contract has 12mo retention. Can security confirm scope and whether this triggers customer notification?
ankur (eng-security): Can you paste the org id + sample request_ids they provided? Also which KMS key are they referencing?
sara (support): org: acme-corp
Sample request_id: req_7f9a34a2
Example curl from customer:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <tok>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage -H "X-Request-Id: req_7f9a34a2"
```
They included KMS key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-1234-ef56-7890
S3 path they expect logs: s3://redwood-audit/prod/acme-corp/2024-09-22/
james (eng-infra): I can confirm a delivery gap in the audit-firehose stream. Observed gap: 2024-09-22T03:14:30Z -> 2024-09-24T02:50:12Z. Forwarder logs show repeated error: `AccessDeniedException: disabled KMS key` when trying to re-encrypt.
deploy-bot: deploy log-forwarder v3.2.1 at 2024-09-22T03:10:12Z (by infra/automated).
audit-bot: CloudTrail event detected: kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion?No, but KeyStateChange: KeyDisabled for key abcd-1234 at 2024-09-22T03:12:08Z.
ankur (eng-security): That lines up. Action items: 1) confirm which orgs used that KMS key 2) determine raw message retention (do we have un-processed/raw events to reprocess?) 3) estimate re-ingestion ETA. Who owns the forwarder role?
james (eng-infra): Forwarder IAM role is `log-forwarder-role`. Looks like key rotation script disabled the old key before attaching grants to the forwarder role for the new key. We still have raw events in Kafka topic `audit-raw-archive` (retention 14 days). We can replay. Error snippet from forwarder log:
```
2024-09-22T03:14:33Z ERROR ReEncrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd-1234-ef56-7890 is disabled
```
maria (cs): If we need to notify customers, what language do we use? ACME is asking whether logs are permanently lost.
leo (legal): If there's potential data loss or contract breach (12mo retention), we must notify affected customers and record timeline. Policy: customer notification within 72 hours for incidents impacting data retention guarantees. Copy legal on the notice.
ankur (eng-security): Preliminary scope: affected orgs are ACME + 8 other orgs that used the same per-customer KMS key (we have a mapping). Time window: 2024-09-22T03:14:30Z -> 2024-09-24T02:50:12Z. Root cause: rotation job disabled previous key before granting new key permissions to forwarder role.
james (eng-infra): Remediation plan: 1) Re-enable old key and re-grant decrypt to forwarder role (temporary) -> immediate fix for ingestion pipeline (ETA 30-60m). 2) Reprocess backlog from `audit-raw-archive` and write re-encrypted files to S3 path expected by customers -> initial batch in ~12h, full backfill for 2.5 days of data ~36-48h. 3) Post-mortem + rollout fix for rotation script (PR in progress).
maria (cs): Draft customer note suggestion: "We're investigating an ingestion issue caused by KMS rotation which temporarily prevented audit logs from being delivered. We are actively re-ingesting logs and expect the initial restore within 12 hours, full restore within 48 hours. We will provide exported copies and a complimentary 3-month retention extension. We're sorry for the disruption." Thoughts? :bow:
leo (legal): That language is OK but include: we do not yet have confirmation of permanent loss; we are treating as potential retention incident. Include contact for escalation and timeline commitments.
ops-oncall: I re-enabled the old key (abcd-1234) and added a temporary policy grant for `log-forwarder-role` at 2024-09-24T04:20Z. Forwarder resumed and ingestion restarted.
james (eng-infra): Re-ingestion started at 2024-09-24T04:28Z. Processing speed ~200GB/hr. Estimated time to complete 2.5 days: ~38 hours. I'll post progress updates here.
sara (support): I'll draft the external notification for ACME and the other affected customers and send to legal + cs for signoff before sending. Can we make the 12h initial restore ETA public once we have the first batch?
ankur (eng-security): Yes. I'll write an incident scope summary and timeline for the compliance report. Add me as investigator for incident-12345.
deploy-bot: incident-12345 created (severity: P2) assigned to ankur.
ankur (eng-security): Recording timeline, tagging postmortem owner. Link to runbook and reprocess playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Audit+Reingest+Runbook
sara (support): Thanks all — sending customer note after legal signoff. Will update thread as re-ingest progresses.
